summary: Iter22 — Frontend P0 verification of BhaktiEditorDrawer at /admin/arti-manager. ALL GREEN. (1) Full Text unsaved indicator: 'Unsaved changes' badge appears on edit, Save button text becomes 'Save Full Text *', both clear after a successful PUT /api/content/items/{id}. (2) Aarti Sync LRC upload: parsed test_aarti.lrc → 2 verses, editor populated with nested JSON ('verses' present, len=745). (3) Aarti Sync JSON upload: parsed test_aarti.json, editor populated (contains 'verses' and 'Test'). (4) Save Sync: POST /api/content/items/{id}/lang/hi/sync succeeded — status banner 'Sync saved for Hindi'. (5) Smoke: Content / Audio / Video / Publish tabs all open without crash overlay or red error banner. The Aarti drawer hides Verses tab (correct — aarti is consumption-only).

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by Emergent visual-edit instrumentation injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers inside <option>{label}</option> at BhaktiEditorDrawer.js:1395. Dev-only noise; does not break the UI. Not a code bug — flagging only as awareness.

critical_code_review_comments: FullTextTab dirty-state wiring is correct: setDirty(true) on every onChange (line 429), setDirty(false) only after a successful PUT (line 369). Badge renders conditionally (line 393-400) and Save button asterisk uses the same flag (line 451). Verified live: badge appeared after one keystroke and was removed after save in one E2E run.

AartiSyncTab .lrc parser (parseLrcToNested, lines 1541-1574) correctly tokenizes [mm:ss.xxx]text and groups every 2 lines into a verse with backfilled end_ms. .json branch normalizes both flat list and nested forms. handleFile resets the input ref so the same file can be re-uploaded — good UX touch. Both formats verified end-to-end: LRC produced 2 verses, JSON populated editor with 'Test' line.
Save Sync POSTs to /api/content/items/{id}/lang/{lang}/sync with the parsed JSON body and surfaces backend errors via setError. Verified 200 response → green status banner 'Sync saved for Hindi'.

Tabs gating: AARTI hides Verses (correct — aarti is one-shot multilingual full text), shows Audio Sync regardless of beginner/expert mode (line 75: mode==='expert' || isAarti). Confirmed in DOM: drawer-tab-verses count=0 when category=aarti.

Minor / non-blocking: All 7 tabs (content, fulltext, verses-conditional, audio, video, sync, publish) carry data-testid='drawer-tab-{id}' and the Sync tab editor uses data-testid='aarti-sync-editor-{lang}', file input data-testid='aarti-sync-file-{lang}', save button data-testid='aarti-sync-save-{lang}' — all the IDs referenced in the review request are wired and clickable.

Dev-only console warning: <span> wrapper injected by Emergent visual-edit annotator inside <select><option> at line 1395 of BhaktiEditorDrawer.js triggers React hydration warning. Source is the build-time instrumentation (x-ve-dynamic spans) — NOT app code. Does not affect functionality.
